items.statement_en: The memory is not a transcript but a set of structured containers, each holding a value plus metadata, so that recall can filter on attributes rather than re-reading raw history.
evidence_quotes: a memory object can be a data container that stores one or more memory values

items.statement_en: Storing memories in the modality in which they were received (audio, image) is meant to preserve context that a text transcription would discard.
evidence_quotes: These audio recordings can capture rich contextual information that may be lost in the transcription

items.statement_en: Keeping the supporting interactions alongside a memory value lets a later contradicting input refine the memory instead of simply overwriting it.
evidence_quotes: new information can serve to refine and build more nuanced memories rather than noisily overcorrecting based on limited information

items.statement_en: Timestamps and optional expiration times on memory objects are the mechanism by which forgetting after an interval is implemented during maintenance cycles.
evidence_quotes: Memory objects exceeding their expiration time may be automatically deleted during scheduled maintenance operations.

items.statement_en: Because the memory is built from conversation, the same conversational channel doubles as the control surface for erasing or limiting it.
evidence_quotes: the user can also use the same interaction mechanism to limit, erase, or otherwise modify the memory of the machine-learned agent system

items.statement_en: Extracting memories offline from cached interactions is positioned as shifting compute away from query time, so runtime inference reads condensed objects rather than raw history.
evidence_quotes: by pre-processing user interactions offline, the system can create high-quality memory data objects containing key features and metadata

items.statement_en: The response can itself be an API call, so recalled memory conditions actions taken on a device, not only text returned to the user.
evidence_quotes: response 122 can include an application programming interface call generated based on output data structure 120

items.statement_en: The disclosure deliberately leaves open where conflict resolution happens: offline consolidation against existing memories, or at runtime with all retrieved memories in view.
evidence_quotes: Runtime queries can be processed in full view of all retrieved memories.

items.statement_en: Ordering recalled values by timestamp is how recency is communicated to the model for resolving conflicting memories.
evidence_quotes: This ordering allows the machine-learned agent system to prioritize more recent context when making inferences.

items.background_problem: Agents without memory force users to re-enter the same details across sessions, and the alternative of wiring the agent to external data sources gives the user an all-or-nothing access choice with data the agent does not curate.
items.asserted_effect: The specification asserts that a user-specific, agent-curated interaction memory lets a task start from a single interaction, supports asynchronous execution of previously instructed tasks, reduces runtime load by pre-processing memories offline, and gives the user control over what is remembered and forgotten.
items.delta: No performance numbers are given; the claimed difference is structural: memory objects generated from prior interactions with the user, retrieved by relevance and fed into a sequence model input, rather than raw history or uncurated external sources.
quotes: the user may be faced with an all-or-nothing choice, which may be undesirable in some circumstances
can initiate execution with a single interaction

items.what_it_shows_en: Overall agent pipeline from input interfaces and query through the memory model, recall cycle, datastore query and response, memory data, input data structure, model system, output data structure, response, and output interfaces.
Structure of the interaction memory datastore as a set of memory objects, each holding memory values and memory metadata.
Example recall cycle in which three retrieved memory objects are condensed into memory data for the model input.
Communication sequence in which a trigger starts a memory update cycle before a later query drives a recall cycle and model inference.
Memory update cycle in which cached inputs are sent to the model system, memory data updates are returned, and a memory data write is executed.
Memory maintenance cycle in which a memory update request with current memory data drives the model to produce memory data updates independent of new input.
Generic sequence processing model that turns inputs into an input sequence and uses prediction layers to emit an output sequence.
Example computing device in which each application carries its own machine learning library and models and talks to device components through an API.
Flowchart of the claimed method: receive query, access memory data, input data structure to sequence model, generate output, output response.

drop_signal.reason: 대화형 에이전트가 사용자별 기억을 쌓고·잊고·정정하는 구조는 일반 독자가 자기 경험(같은 말 반복 입력, 잊어달라는 요청)에 바로 잇댈 수 있어 안도감 서사가 성립한다. 성능 수치는 없으나 구조적 차이(사용자 발화로 만든 기억 객체 · 지원 기록 · 만료 기반 망각)가 명확하다.

review_requests.reason: FIG-8 방식(기존 기억 미참조)과 FIG-9 방식(기존 기억 참조)을 「의도적으로 열어 둔 선택」으로 읽었는데, 명세서는 두 접근의 장단만 나열할 뿐 선택을 열어 둔다고 명시하지 않으므로 [0291]을 보고 inferred 유지 여부를 판가름해 달라.
